package.name: marine_control_bridge_client
package.description: Operator-side, no-Qt helper for marine_control's dynamic bridge wiring (unh_marine_autonomy ADR-0003 D7-dyn): discover controllable devices from udp_bridge bridge_info, and connect/disconnect their state/change topics on explicit request via the local udp_bridge's remote_subscribe/advertise and remove_subscribe/advertise services. Consumed by rqt_marine_control.
